'''Hogan Tinmar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He served [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] as an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] driver on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Tinmar was active on Naboo during the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]]. He was present with the group where [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] asked [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Nass]] to help in their conflict against the Trade Federation.

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he transported Amidala to the [[Christo's apartment/Legends|apartment]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Christo/Legends|Christo]], with senator [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] not far behind. while he was waiting for her outside, the bounty hunter [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]] distracted him with the motor noise from his [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]], and drove away. Just a split-second later he was attacked by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Chata Hyoki/Legends|Chata Hyoki]] and somehow incapacitated.

Later in the war, he relocated back to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and became one of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Neeyutnee/Legends|Neeyutnee's]] guards. He accompanied the queen to greet Senator Amidala when she arrived on her homeworld at the beginning of the [[Skirmish on Naboo/Legends|skirmish]] between the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] and an alliance between the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. He also accompanied the queen during a prisoner exchange, releasing General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] back to the Confederacy who in turn released [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].
